newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Moldovan PM Ciubuc begins visit to Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Moldovan PM Ciubuc begins visit to Hungary.

text.p: Moldovan Prime Minister Ion Ciubuc arrived in Hungary on Tuesday for a two-day official visit at the invitation of his Hungarian counterpart Gyula Horn, MTI news agency said.
Ciubuc will meet President Arpad Goncz, Horn and parliamentary speaker Zoltan Gal.
The two prime ministers will on Wednesday sign seven bilateral agreements, including an accord on cooperation against organised crime, terrorism and drug trafficking, MTI said.
